document.name: Brooklearn Birthday Parties
document.shortDescription: Brooklearn in Carroll Gardens offers all-inclusive birthday party packages in its neighborhood playspace, with weekend birthday availability and a family-focused indoor setting for young children.
document.longDescription:
Brooklearn's official parties page says the playspace offers all-inclusive birthday party packages and invites families to choose from three distinct party packages. The page says the team will work with families to make the day extra special and recommends booking two to three months in advance to secure a preferred date and time.

Brooklearn lists its address as 380 Court Street, Brooklyn, NY 11231, with phone (929) 256-2377 and emails info@brooklearnbrooklyn.com and Jenna@brooklearnbrooklyn.com. The official about page describes Brooklearn as a neighborhood playroom created for children and families, and says its playspace is excellent for children 6 months to 6 years of age.

The official site also says Saturday and Sunday are closed for birthday parties on the playspace-hours block, which indicates weekend party scheduling rather than regular public playspace hours. The public parties page reviewed did not publish package prices, so ClassScout stores pricing as unknown.

Sources: https://www.brooklearnbrooklyn.com/parties https://www.brooklearnbrooklyn.com/about https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/66987fb06f38b937b095f565/6d4a61a9-bd2f-47a3-a917-8d8bca9e7d19/IMG_7907.jpeg?format=1500w
